Curriculum Stages

A Learning Journey, Stage by Stage

Age 1.5 – 5 yrs
Pre-Primary — Play Class, Nursery, LKG, UKG

Play-way learning, phonics, motor skills, and social development in a warm, nurturing environment designed for the youngest learners.

Class I – V
Primary

Foundational literacy and numeracy, EVS, activity-based projects, and early exposure to computers, art, and languages.

Class VI – VIII
Middle School

Subject specialisation begins — Science, Mathematics, Social Science, Sanskrit/Hindi/English — supported by lab work and project learning.

Class IX – X
Secondary (CBSE Board)

Structured board-exam preparation with regular assessments, doubt-clearing sessions, and skill-based NEP 2020 electives.

Senior Secondary (XI–XII)
Science — PCM Science — PCB Commerce Arts / Humanities
Our Pedagogy

Beyond the Textbook

Academics at Sanskar International School Hajipur go well beyond textbooks and rote memorisation. Every classroom is designed around the NEP 2020 vision of experiential, competency-based learning.

What Makes Our Classrooms Different

  • Smart classrooms with digital, multimedia-supported teaching.
  • Activity-based and project-based learning across all subjects.
  • Regular formative assessments — not just term-end exams.
  • Dedicated computer lab, library, and science laboratories.
  • Focus on communication skills, critical thinking, and life skills alongside academics.
  • Sanskrit and Hindi taught alongside English to build strong linguistic roots.

Assessment Philosophy

We follow the CBSE continuous and comprehensive evaluation approach — combining periodic tests, projects, class participation, and term examinations — so a child's true growth is tracked, not just a single exam score.
